extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from XML/PDF text, figure captions, and local supplementary landing pages; claims are limited to assays present in the local material.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Pep27anal2 shows low-to-moderate human erythrocyte hemolysis at the highest tested table concentration and localizes at the Jurkat cell plasma membrane before intracellular signal appears; this supports membrane interaction/entry context, not uncontrolled lytic activity.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The local source supports membrane interaction and cellular entry context, but not a resolved molecular receptor or transport mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Annexin V/PI flow cytometry and electron microscopy support apoptosis-associated cell death with relatively limited membrane-integrity loss compared with the pore-forming control.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Apoptosis phenotype is source-supported; exact downstream execution pathway remains bounded by the assays reported.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The local source reports no detectable cytochrome c release under the tested conditions and states that pan-caspase inhibition did not abrogate activity; final mechanism is therefore preserved as caspase/cytochrome-c-independent in this assay context.
direct_assay_types: pan-caspase inhibitor response reported in text
mechanism_claims.limitations: The caspase-inhibitor point is reported as data not shown; it should not be promoted beyond a source-reported contextual mechanism statement.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: NMR and RP-HPLC/sequence tables support a structure-function association between hydrophobic substitutions, longer helical region for Pep27anal2, and stronger anticancer activity in the tested cell lines.
